exitCodes.meaning: The command completed — hunks were absorbed, or there was nothing to do (nothing staged, no confident hunk, or a --dry-run plan). The payload reports the distribution either way; hunks with no confident target stay staged and are reported, never guessed.
Invalid arguments — an unknown or duplicated flag. The only accepted form is an optional --dry-run.
The absorb could not be completed for a reason the other codes do not name — a signing failure among them.
Blocked on conflicts (blocked_on_conflicts) — the index already held unmerged entries, or the autosquash rebase could not apply cleanly and is left in progress, resumable.

flags.help: Report the planned distribution without touching anything.

summary: Distribute the staged hunks into the commits that last touched their lines.
